messages.text: This is terminal ileum: stem cells and Paneth cells sit at the crypt bases.

You said Paneth cells sit at the crypt bases with the stem cells. The data agree: they are hidden inside Stem cells. Stem-cell sub-cluster /2 (550 cells, at depth 0, the epithelium closest to the muscle) has ITLN2 in 94% of its cells against 3% of the other epithelial cells, plus KLK12, SEC11C and AZGP1. Paneth cells got no cells because their markers ITLN1 and SPINK4 belong to goblet cells here. I give Paneth cells their own markers and add KLK12- to Stem cells and Goblet cells. Next problem: Arterial EC has 2,633 cells, but only sub-cluster /3 (313 cells, HEY1 82%, BMX 37%) is arterial; the rest is mainly capillaries, and Capillary EC got only 22 cells, which look like myeloid cells. I also replace weak or unspecific markers: Cycling TAs (PCLAF, UBE2C), Goblet cells (SPDEF in 7%), Enterocytes (FABP2), Effector/memory CD4 T cells (fold 0.98), ILCs (IL7R), PDGFRA-hi telocytes (SOX6 in 17%) and Migratory DCs (IL4I1). Optional: gd T cells (the NK cells have TRDC in 57% and CD3E in 47%), a MYH11+ ACTG2+ DES+ type inside the telocytes, and removing Eosinophils, which this panel cannot detect.
? FDCs were not found (FDCSP in 168 cells, 23 with 2+ transcripts). Are there Peyer's patches or lymphoid follicles in this section? If not, Follicular dendritic cells can be removed.
? cDC2 markers are weak (CLEC10A in 31%) and cDC2 are confused with Monocytes (0.16). The panel has no CD1C or FCER1A. Keep cDC2 as it is, or merge it into Dendritic cells?

edits.problem: Paneth cells hidden among Stem cells
edits.reason: You place Paneth cells at the crypt bases with the stem cells. ITLN2 is the Paneth-specific gene in the panel; ITLN1 and SPINK4 are goblet-cell genes here (ITLN1 in 86% of Goblet cells), so the old markers never formed a Paneth group.
edits.evidence: Stem-cell sub-cluster /2 (550 cells, depth 0, spatial clustering 1.48): ITLN2 in 94% (45% of the other stem cells; 3% of the other epithelial cells), KLK12 in 47% (6%), SEC11C in 77% (33%), AZGP1 in 77% (33%). Stem cells lie closest to the muscle of all epithelium (median 288 um, i.e. at the crypt base).
edits.group: Paneth cells hidden among Stem cells

edits.problem: Paneth cells hidden among Stem cells
edits.reason: Keeps the Paneth cells out of Stem cells.
edits.evidence: KLK12 in 47% of stem sub-cluster /2 (Paneth-like), 6% of the other stem cells.
edits.group: Paneth cells hidden among Stem cells

edits.problem: Paneth cells hidden among Stem cells
edits.reason: SPDEF is weak. REP15 and ERN2 separate goblet cells better, and the negatives keep Paneth cells out.
edits.evidence: SPDEF in 7% of goblet cells; REP15 in 59% (13% of other epithelial cells), ERN2 in 66% (23%), SPINK4 in 77% (26%).
edits.group: Paneth cells hidden among Stem cells

edits.reason: PCLAF and UBE2C are detected in few of these cells.
edits.evidence: PCLAF 13%, UBE2C 21%; RRM2 in 53% (6% of other epithelial cells), TYMS in 48% (5%).

edits.reason: FABP2 is not specific: the other epithelial types detect it about as often.
edits.evidence: FABP2 in 90% vs 70% of the other epithelial cells; MGAM in 72% (13%), CYP3A4 in 60% (8%), APOB in 84% (14%).

edits.problem: Arterial EC holds capillaries; Capillary EC almost empty
edits.reason: GJA4 is in only 10% of the cells. Only one sub-cluster of Arterial EC is arterial; the others are mucosal capillaries and vessels with fibroblast or muscle transcripts.
edits.evidence: Arterial EC sub-cluster /3 (313 of 2,633 cells, spatial clustering 4.81): HEY1 in 82% (21% of the other Arterial EC), BMX in 37% (5%). Sub-cluster /0 (877 cells, depth 0) has no arterial genes; Arterial EC also has CD36 in 47% and CA4 in 18% (capillary genes).
edits.group: Arterial EC holds capillaries; Capillary EC almost empty

edits.problem: Arterial EC holds capillaries; Capillary EC almost empty
edits.reason: The 22 Capillary EC cells are myeloid-like (CYBB, CD14). The capillaries sit in Arterial EC, which has CD36 and CA4.
edits.evidence: Capillary EC: 22 cells, median confidence 0.47, top genes CYBB 55%, CD14 23%; CD36 in 47% of Arterial EC vs 15% of their siblings, CA4 18% vs 0%. Shares in the capillary sub-cluster itself not checked.
edits.group: Arterial EC holds capillaries; Capillary EC almost empty

edits.problem: Arterial EC holds capillaries; Capillary EC almost empty
edits.reason: PLVAP does not separate venous cells from their siblings; ACKR1 alone is decisive.
edits.evidence: PLVAP in 64% of Venous EC and 64% of the siblings; ACKR1 in 77% vs 8%.
edits.group: Arterial EC holds capillaries; Capillary EC almost empty

edits.reason: The markers are found as often in the other T and NK cells as in these (fold 0.98); GZMK and CD40LG are rarely detected.
edits.evidence: GZMK in 7%, CD40LG in 15%; CD69 in 49% (19% of the other CD4 T cells), CCL5 in 43% (13%).

edits.reason: The cells carry transcripts of the migratory DCs next to them, so the type picks up DCs.
edits.evidence: LAMP3 in 39% of Naive CD4 T cells (2% of the other CD4 T cells), with FSCN1 33% and CCL19 34%; SELL in only 18%.
IL7R in 96% of ILCs and 76% of the other T and NK cells; RORC (70% vs 8%) and KIT (79% vs 4%) remain.

edits.problem: gd T cells inside NK cells
edits.question: Should the TRDC+ CD3+ cells now called NK cells become gd T cells (common among intraepithelial lymphocytes of the ileum)?
edits.reason: TRDV1 and TRGV4 are rarely detected, so gd T cells got no cells. The cells called NK cells often carry TRDC and CD3E.
edits.evidence: NK cells: TRDC in 57% (3% of the other T and NK cells), CD3E detected in 47% despite CD3E-; KLRC2 67%, CD160 41%. The shares of TRDC+CD3E+ cells within NK cells were not checked.
edits.group: gd T cells inside NK cells

edits.evidence: SOX6 in 17% of telocytes; F3 44% (10% of the other fibroblasts), BMP5 42% (2%).

edits.reason: SOX6 is no longer used, so BMP5 becomes the negative marker that separates these cells from the telocytes.
edits.evidence: BMP5 in 42% of telocytes vs 2% here.

edits.question: Do you want the contractile PDGFRA+ cells under the epithelium (myofibroblasts, or villus-core and muscularis mucosae smooth muscle) separate from the telocytes?
edits.reason: One telocyte sub-cluster is contractile and sits apart.
edits.evidence: PDGFRA-hi telocytes sub-cluster /3 (417 cells, depth 7.5 um, spatial clustering 1.56): MYH11 in 92% (19% of the other telocytes), ACTG2 82% (19%), DES 42% (4%).

edits.question: Needed if you add the myofibroblast type: the negative marker would keep its cells out of Fibroblasts.
edits.reason: MYH11- is already detected as often in fibroblasts as in their siblings.
edits.evidence: MYH11 in 35% of fibroblasts vs 37% of their siblings.

edits.reason: Replace the weak IL4I1 with CD83.
edits.evidence: IL4I1 in 19% (9% of the other DCs); CD83 in 75% (11%).

edits.problem: Types the panel does not detect
edits.question: Remove Eosinophils? This panel hardly detects their transcripts.
edits.reason: The panel does not detect them.
edits.evidence: Among 2,487 myeloid cells: CLC in 5 cells, CCR3 in 2.
edits.group: Types the panel does not detect
